description: Frontend: Update the pending mentions feature to use the new backend API endpoint instead of client-side filtering, and add a dismiss (X) button to each item in the list.
steps: 1. Create a new API module `app/javascript/mastodon/api/pending_mentions.ts` with functions: `apiFetchPendingMentions(params?: { max_id?: string; since_id?: string; min_id?: string; limit?: number })` that calls `GET /api/v1/pending_mentions`, and `apiDismissPendingMention(id: string)` that calls `DELETE /api/v1/pending_mentions/:id`. Follow the pattern in `app/javascript/mastodon/api/notifications.ts`.

2. Create Redux actions in `app/javascript/mastodon/actions/pending_mentions.ts` using `createDataLoadingThunk` (following the pattern in `app/javascript/mastodon/actions/notification_groups.ts`). Actions: `fetchPendingMentions` (fetches from API, imports accounts/statuses, returns notification data), `dismissPendingMention` (calls dismiss API and removes from local state).

3. Create a Redux slice/reducer `app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/pending_mentions.ts` to store the pending mentions state: `{ items: NotificationGroup[], isLoading: boolean, hasMore: boolean, next: string | null }`. Handle the fetch fulfilled/pending/rejected actions and the dismiss action (remove item from list on success).
4. Register the new reducer in the root store (`app/javascript/mastodon/store/index.ts` or equivalent store configuration file).

5. Update `app/javascript/mastodon/features/pending_mentions/index.tsx` to: (a) dispatch `fetchPendingMentions` on mount instead of relying on the notifications selector, (b) read from the new pending_mentions reducer state, (c) support pagination (load more on scroll), (d) render each notification item with a dismiss button (X icon in top-right corner). For the dismiss button, follow the pattern from `notification_follow_request.tsx` using `IconButton` with `CloseIcon` from `@/material-icons/400-24px/close.svg?react`.

6. The dismiss button should be positioned at the top-right of each notification item. Create a wrapper component or modify the rendering of each notification group item to include the dismiss button. The button calls `dismissPendingMention(notificationId)` on click.
7. Update localization strings in `app/javascript/mastodon/locales/en.json` and `app/javascript/mastodon/locales/ko.json`: add `pending_mentions.dismiss` key (en: 'Dismiss', ko: '해제').

8. Remove or deprecate the old `selectPendingMentionGroups` selector in `app/javascript/mastodon/selectors/notifications.ts` since it is no longer needed (or keep it as a fallback but the main feature should use the API).
acceptance_criteria: The /pending-mentions page loads data from the dedicated backend API endpoint GET /api/v1/pending_mentions
Each mention item in the list has a visible X (dismiss) button in the top-right area
Clicking the dismiss button removes the item from the list and calls DELETE /api/v1/pending_mentions/:id
Pagination works: scrolling to the bottom loads more items if available
The page still shows the explanation text and empty state message as before
verification: Run `yarn lint` to ensure no linting errors
Run `yarn test` to verify no test regressions
Manually verify the component renders correctly by reviewing the code structure
